lines.text: Many learners say: I and my friend went to the park.
Better: My friend and I went to the park.
Put I last: my friend and I.
My sister and I! My sister and I went to the market.

data.wrong: I and my friend went to the park.
data.right: My friend and I went to the park.
data.why: Put I last: my friend and I.

native.tip: نقول «أنا وصديقي»، أما في الإنجليزية فنضع I في النهاية: “My friend and I went to the park.” وليس “I and my friend went to the park.”
native.caption: هل تقول أحيانًا هذه الجملة؟ “I and my friend went to the park.” 😅 نقول «أنا وصديقي» فنبدأ بـ«أنا»، أما في الإنجليزية فنضع I في النهاية، فالجملة الصحيحة “My friend and I went to the park.” استمع إلى Ama وكرّر! تدرّب أكثر في تطبيق Lexkite.

en.hook: Do you say “I and my friend”?
en.tip: In Arabic we say «أنا وصديقي» and start with «أنا», but in English we put I last: “My friend and I went to the park.” not “I and my friend went to the park.”
en.caption: Do you sometimes say this? “I and my friend went to the park.” 😅 In Arabic we say «أنا وصديقي» and start with «أنا», but in English we put I last, so the right sentence is “My friend and I went to the park.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
